477399445.query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM contributions
        WHERE 1=1
        AND ST_Intersects(geom, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((8.407288 49.346599, 8.839874 49.346599, 8.839874 49.532339, 8.407288 49.532339, 8.407288 49.346599))', 4326))
        AND valid_to > '2026-01-01'::timestamptz
        AND (((tags @> $1) OR (tags @> $2 AND (tags @> $3 OR tags @> $4)) OR (tags @> $5) OR (tags @> $6) OR (tags @> $7 AND tags @> $8) OR (tags ? $9 AND NOT tags @> $10) OR (tags @> $11)) AND (status_geom_type).geom_type = 'LineString');
